formation: Depicts a person with an emphasized eye (𦰋) sleeping on a bed (爿), conveying the meaning "dream". 𦰋 also represents the sound. The 爿 (bed) component was later reanalyzed as meaning component 夕 (evening).

components.note: Depicts a person (人) with an emphasized eye (𥄕).
Originally 爿, which depicted a bed. Later reanalyzed as meaning component 夕 (evening).
